_comment: Curated, presentation-only wallet identities. Highest precedence in build_wallet_names/build_wallet_avatars, above OpenSea usernames and verified ENS. Deliberately NOT scripts/labels.json: that file's `type` drives trace_core/trace_flows recursion, and these entries carry no claim about wallet class. `avatar_file` names a file in data/media/wallets/, served from the CDN under nftina/wallets/.

0xfdb120707feab4215117267a0269fec1a28ec4.name: Argos Anon
0xfdb120707feab4215117267a0269fec1a28ec4.note: Holds exactly 87 MetaZoo Coin Tokens, matching the count Argos stated publicly for the Tribe's shared holdings ('The Tribe currently has 87 coins'). OpenSea reports the username 'AI_ChatBot' for this address; the curated name is used instead.

0x3dd341664b2ffeedf9be108d4fa926dedfa9a0.name: MetaZoo Genesis deployer
0x3dd341664b2ffeedf9be108d4fa926dedfa9a0.note: Created the Genesis 2021 contract 0xa0529c32 on 2021-03-13 (Etherscan getcontractcreation, via deploy factory 0x3e8b1732) and minted all 595 tokens in nine batches through 2021-11. Also the configured distributor for genesis_2021 and mintable_early. Has no OpenSea username, ENS or web3.bio identity: both profile fetches return empty for it. See F56.
